verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party Splits feature divides the inbox into focused tabbed inboxes. Splits can be defined by importance, built-in labels, custom labels, specific senders or complex search queries, so different email types are handled at different times rather than in arrival order. Community users praise the related Bundles grouping, though not Splits itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of newsletter and calendar-invite splits (only implied via labels or queries), and independent hands-on corroboration of Splits specifically.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: They’re a simple way to divide your one big inbox into multiple smaller, more focused inboxes – each in its own tab.
Splits let you handle different types of emails at different times, so you can stay responsive where it matters most.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
